facts.fact: At the 6 May 2026 presentation the interior ministry's director general said the reform needed changes to the family code, whose provisions still mandated manual registration of civil records; the article says the authorities have long managed civil registration records manually.

facts.fact: On 6 May 2026 the Ministry of the Interior, Community Development and Public Security presented a digital platform for civil registration management and biometric identity card production; the authorities said the infrastructure was nearly complete and awaited a decree governing the system's use.
